key_contribution: Presents a fully integrated UAV navigation system with extensive real-world experimental validation in cluttered, GPS-denied warehouse environments.
Presents a UAV localization method using AprilTags and BIM for GPS-denied indoor construction environments with experimental validation against ground truth.
Proposes GBDTpose, a graphics-based digital twin framework for accurate UAV localization in GPS-denied environments, validated numerically (SITL) and in field tests on a bridge.
Proposes a multi-UAV relative localization (SLAM) and motion planning framework explicitly for GPS-denied environments with experimental validation.
Presents radio SLAM using signals of opportunity for resilient PNT in real GPS-jammed environments, validated experimentally on a ground vehicle under 90 dB jamming.
Proposes ReFDrone, a visible-light 4DoF indoor drone localization system for GNSS-denied environments using rolling-shutter AoA, with extensive experimental evaluation.
Presents a perception and navigation system for autonomous quadrotor navigation in GPS-denied environments with localization, mapping, and waypoint following validated in simulation and real world.
Presents a low-cost UAV (SmartCopter) using a smartphone for mapping, localization, and navigation in unknown GPS-denied indoor environments with demonstrated experiments.
Presents TRAELS, a terrain-referenced navigation localization system for UGVs in unstructured outdoor GNSS-denied environments, with demonstrated absolute trajectory error below 3 m.
Presents a deep cross-modality geo-localization framework for UAVSAR imagery in GPS-denied environments (urban canyons, jamming) with RMSE of 1.83-2.86 m across extensive experiments.
Presents a visual odometry method using satellite imagery comparison to reduce accumulated error for fixed-wing UAV navigation in GPS-denied zones, validated in real-world flights.
Develops a single 3D LiDAR mapping and localization system for GNSS-denied environments using LiDAR odometry, particle-filter virtual GNSS, and GraphSLAM, validated on 3.7-6.5 km datasets.
Presents an Adaptive Kalman Filter framework for precise position estimation of a multirotor UAV in GPS-denied indoor environments using only LIDAR and IMU.
Proposes a multi-sensor fusion autonomous navigation method for indoor UAVs in GPS-denied substations using laser SLAM and AprilTag relocation with Dijkstra/DWA path planning.
Proposes LiVIC-EKF, a LiDAR-visual-inertial multi-sensor fusion framework for 6DoF pose estimation in underground GNSS-denied coal mines, validated on the KITTI dataset.
Presents OPsCV, a GNSS-denied UAV navigation framework fusing deep inertial odometry with cross-view geolocalization via an error-state Kalman filter, evaluated on real UAV flight data.
Presents R-LVIO, a resilient LiDAR-visual-inertial odometry system for UAV self-localization in GNSS-denied environments, validated on private and public UAV datasets.
Presents a CNN-based UAV localization method using pre-existing satellite imagery to replace GPS, achieving average localization error under 8 m in GPS-denied flight.
Presents an air-ground cooperative UAV navigation system using mobile-anchor trilateration, UWB, and environmental modeling with D* Lite path planning for GPS-denied unknown environments.
Proposes an indoor UAV localization framework fusing UWB multi-anchor calibration with factor graph optimization and VIO constraints, validated on public datasets and real-world indoor flights.
Presents radio SLAM exploiting ambient signals of opportunity for resilient navigation in GPS-denied (jammed) environments, including first published real-world GPS-jamming navigation experiments.
Presents a low-cost multisensor method for robust UAV pose reconstruction for navigation in visually degraded, GNSS-denied sewer environments, validated via simulation and real-world experiments.
Presents a real-time localization and mapping system fusing wheel odometry, IMU, and VIO with ORB-SLAM2 for agricultural robots in GPS-denied greenhouse environments, validated experimentally.

Presents Hybrid-RIO, a radar-inertial odometry system fusing four-directional FMCW mmWave radars with IMU for robust UAV positioning and autonomous navigation in GPS-denied low-light indoor environments.

Presents VG-Fusion, a visual geo-localization method fused with IMU and LiDAR-inertial odometry via factor graph optimization for UAVs in GNSS-denied field environments, validated on public and own datasets.
Proposes an enhanced UAV navigation system integrating monocular camera, UWB, and INS with EKF weighting for GNSS-denied operation, validated in an experimental flight.
Presents a robust 6-DoF absolute visual localization method for UAVs via deep homography estimation fused with incremental motion, validated on real-world UAV datasets in GNSS-denied conditions.

Presents H-CoRE, a cooperative multi-robot framework with multi-sensor fusion localization and mapping for autonomous operations in GNSS-denied indoor environments, deployed and experimentally validated.

Presents a relative navigation architecture combining visual graph-SLAM with a multiplicative extended Kalman filter for vision-based aerial GPS-denied navigation, verified with hardware flight tests.
Presents an aerial localization and navigation system for GNSS-denied maritime surveillance using LoRa localization and RGB camera with Kalman filtering, validated in a full mission field test.
Proposes a magnetometer-enhanced visual-inertial odometry algorithm for fixed-wing UAVs in GNSS-denied high-altitude environments, validated on a 15 km long-range real flight.
Presents a UAV scene matching method combining triplet relationships and sliding mode control for positioning in GPS-denied environments, with extensive experimental validation.
Presents a master-slave cross-domain (UAV-UGV) cooperative localization strategy for GNSS-denied environments using UWB ranging and EKF fusion, validated in field experiments.
Presents a context-sensitive Guidance, Navigation and Control framework for autonomous vehicles in GNSS-denied underground mines, integrating SLAM, map fusion, and odometry with fleet coordination.
Presents an autonomous navigation system for forestry quadrotors in GPS-denied below-canopy environments using SVO-based SLAM and improved RRT path planning.
Presents VecMapLocNet, a vision-based UAV localization method using vector maps and cross-modal matching for GNSS-denied environments, validated across seven cities and in real-world trials.
Presents a low-cost UAV using a smartphone as the onboard processing unit for mapping, localization, and navigation in GPS-denied indoor environments, with demonstrated experiments.
Proposes a lane-level positioning method fusing an inertial dead-reckoning system with HMM-based vector map matching for unmanned driving in GNSS-denied environments, validated to under 30 cm error.
Proposes a robust LiDAR-IMU SLAM solution for real-time geospatial positioning of speedy UAVs in GPS-denied environments, numerically verified at high speeds.
Presents a visual-inertial navigation system using sparse and dense optical flow within an EKF for small UAVs in GNSS-denied indoor environments, with simulation-based verification.
Presents a complete autonomous navigation system for micro aerial vehicles in complex GNSS-denied indoor environments using 3D laser scanner SLAM and multi-layered trajectory planning.
Proposes a fast UAV image localization method in GNSS-denied environments using image sequence relationships and LightGlue feature matching, with positioning errors under 0.5 m.
Presents a localization system for small UAVs in GPS-denied environments using camera-LiDAR fusion with texel image correction and Error-State EKF, validated in experimental flight.
Presents a UAV system with multi-sensor SLAM and A*/3DVFH+ local path planning for autonomous navigation and reconstruction in GNSS-denied environments, with comprehensive experiments.

Presents an anchor-free UAV-UGV collaborative localization framework fusing VIO with UWB ranging via factor graphs with adaptive weighting and outlier suppression, validated in real-world large-scale GNSS-denied environments.
Presents an event-based visual-inertial odometry approach for UAV indoor navigation in GNSS-denied environments, evaluated on simulated and real-world datasets with real-time performance.

Presents a synchronous UAV-humanoid robot collaboration for autonomous mapping and navigation in GNSS-denied search and rescue using SLAM, OctoMap, and adaptive Monte-Carlo localization, validated in a proof-of-concept.
Presents a radar-inertial localization pipeline for UGVs in GNSS-denied off-road environments (dense forest and underground mine) using adaptive EKF and factor-graph ICP fusion.
Presents MiFly, a 6DoF drone self-localization system using a single mmWave backscatter anchor fused with IMU, operating in GPS-denied and low-visibility settings, with extensive evaluation.

Presents an integrated UWB-vision framework combining UWB relative localization, Apriltag positioning, and IMU for autonomous UAV approach and landing in GPS-denied environments, validated experimentally.
Presents an updatable graphics-based digital twin approach with adaptive neural pose regression for robust absolute UAV localization in GPS-denied civil infrastructure, validated on a custom drone.
Presents a unified voxel-centric LiDAR-visual-inertial SLAM framework for large-scale GNSS-denied environments, evaluated at kilometer scale.
Proposes a GNSS-denied UAV terrain matching navigation method based on autoencoder networks with contrastive learning (GL-DualNet, ACLM), validated on a public terrain dataset.
Presents CLAK, a CNN-LSTM-Attention-KAN deep learning framework for non-visual UAV localization in GNSS-denied environments using LiDAR, barometric altitude, and IMU, validated in simulation.

Presents an inertially-assisted semi-direct visual navigation system (IA-VNS) with PI-inspired inertial priors to reduce horizontal drift for autonomous UAVs in GNSS-denied environments, validated via high-fidelity Monte Carlo simulation.
Presents a heterogeneous UAV-ASV multirobot system integrating sensor fusion, localization, and mission planning for maritime inspection in GNSS-denied scenarios, with field trial results.
Presents a monocular SLAM-based autonomous navigation system for micro helicopters using only a camera and inertial sensors in unknown GPS-denied environments, validated in real experiments.
Proposes a particle-filtered relative visual localization algorithm using ORB features and IMU data for UAV navigation in GNSS-denied environments, with demonstrated accuracy and speed improvements.
Presents LoLa-SLAM, a low-latency LiDAR SLAM framework using scan slicing and concurrent matching for real-time 6D pose estimation in indoor UAV navigation, evaluated with ground-truth validation.
Presents an efficient quaternion-based SLAM framework for real-time UAV navigation in GPS-denied environments, validated on the KAIST visual-inertial odometry dataset.
Proposes a landmark-based multi-sensor fusion SLAM algorithm for autonomous positioning in GNSS-denied environments, with experiments in 2D and 3D spaces.
Presents a multi-sensorial SLAM system for low-cost micro aerial vehicles in GPS-denied indoor environments, integrating vision, laser, and inertial measurements via EKF, validated experimentally.
Presents DTVIRM-Swarm, a distributed anchor-free tightly integrated visual-inertial-UWB-magnetic system for UAV swarm cooperative localization in GNSS-denied environments, with real-world validation.
Presents indoor fixed-point hovering control for UAVs based on visual-inertial SLAM and EKF fusion in GPS-denied environments, with experimental validation.
Presents a tethered UAV-UGV marsupial system for long-duration GNSS-denied inspection using Direct LiDAR Localization and coordinated planning, validated in over four hours of experiments.
Presents a machine-learning vision localization framework using a dual-camera system for UAV operation in GPS-denied under-structure (bridge) environments, with experimental evaluation.
Presents an autonomous aerial transport system for marine GNSS-denied environments using anchor-based UWB and QR-code localization, validated in outdoor experiments and competition.
Presents an adaptive particle filter-neural network fusion framework for cooperative localization of multi-UAV systems in GNSS-denied indoor environments, validated in six-UAV simulations.

Presents a distributed group covariance compensation adaptive Kalman filter for multi-UAV cooperative localization in pseudolite-augmented GNSS-denied regions, validated on a large semi-physical testbed.
Presents a magnetic field-based SLAM framework integrating a physics-informed neural network with an unscented Kalman filter for indoor GPS-denied navigation, validated on real-world datasets.
Presents cross-fusion, a cross-session 3D LiDAR and monocular camera fusion method for real-time UAV localization in GPS-denied environments, with performance comparable to GPS-based methods.
Presents a coarse-to-fine visual geo-localization method for GNSS-denied UAVs using oblique-view imagery and orthographic references, validated on public and self-collected datasets.
Presents the SatLoc dataset and SatLoc-Fusion, a hierarchical adaptive fusion framework for micro-UAV localization in GNSS-denied environments, achieving real-time on-edge operation.
Presents SWA-PF, a semantic-weighted adaptive particle filter for memory-efficient 4-DoF UAV localization in GNSS-denied environments using UAV imagery and satellite maps, validated on a new dataset.
Presents a visual SLAM-based autonomous UAV system with dual-link edge architecture for monitoring in GPS-denied commercial greenhouses, validated in 27 days of field deployment.

Presents enhancements to a visual-inertial odometry algorithm (IMU motion prediction, multi-camera support, adaptive feature selection) to improve robustness and accuracy of drone pose estimation in GNSS-denied environments.
Presents a technique combining UWB positioning with visual-inertial odometry via nonlinear optimization for GNSS-denied UAV indoor navigation, validated in real-world scenes.

Presents a UAV visual localization system for GNSS-denied environments integrating image matching, visual odometry, and terrain-weighted constraint optimization, validated in twenty experiments including night conditions.

Presents HCCNet, a hybrid coupled cooperative localization network combining camera, UWB, and IMU with D-RANSAC for robust indoor UAV localization in GPS-denied environments, validated experimentally.

Presents a multi-modality fusion global localization method for UGVs in rough terrain GNSS-denied environments using VO, LiDAR odometry, dead reckoning, and road network detection, validated in field navigation.
Presents a novel scene-matching positioning approach for low-altitude UAVs in GNSS-denied urban environments using HMM retrieval, elevation-difference pose recovery, and factor graph optimization.

Presents REOLA, a real-time elevation and orientation-aware visual localization architecture for GNSS-denied drone navigation using satellite imagery, deep learning, and RLHF, with real-time embedded deployment.
Presents a complete autonomous navigation system (perception, motion planning, and control) for micro-aerial vehicles in GPS-denied environments, validated by experimental testing.

Presents a centralized error-state Kalman filter approach using range-only inter-UAV measurements for cooperative navigation of UAV fleets in GPS-denied (jammed) environments, validated in simulation.
Presents a swarm UAV system (SUAVE) for area mapping in GPS-denied locations using SLAM with LiDAR, camera, and IMU localization, demonstrated via fused multi-UAV autonomous test flights.
Presents a self-calibrated navigation system fusing distance measurements from anchors with visual odometry for GNSS-denied localization, validated on datasets and real-world experiments.

Presents a global visual-inertial ground vehicle state estimation system for GPS-denied environments using multi-stereo VIO and orthographic image registration to georeferenced imagery with pose graph fusion.

Presents a robust GNSS-denied UAV localization method combining particle filter and visual odometry with map-relative matching, demonstrating superior accuracy over ORB-SLAM2 on simulated aerial imagery.

Presents a minimalistic monocular SLAM system using a barometer for metric scale recovery applied to micro aerial vehicles in GPS-denied environments, with observability analysis and real data validation.
Presents an autonomous UAV localization method for low-altitude GNSS-denied urban environments based on POI and store-signage text matching in UAV images, verified with real flight data.

Presents a visual-inertial fusion mapping and localization system using AprilTag with factor-graph optimization and Error-State Kalman Filter for GNSS-denied scenes, validated in simulation and reality.
Presents the SFLY swarm of vision-controlled micro flying robots for autonomous navigation, 3D mapping, and surveillance in GPS-denied environments using only an onboard camera and IMU.

Presents FMC-SVIL, a fiducial marker-corrected stereo visual-inertial localization method for UAV navigation in large-scale GPS-denied bridge environments, validated with RMSE results under sunny and cloudy conditions.
Presents a dual quaternion-based unscented Kalman filter with visual-inertial odometry for state estimation in GPS-denied navigation, validated on the EuRoC MAV dataset.
Presents a decentralized multi-UAV cooperative 3D frontier exploration framework using stereo-camera RTAB-Map SLAM and RRT* planning in GPS-denied environments.
Presents a self-attention LSTM hybrid network (SALSTM) to enhance integrated navigation for small UAVs in GNSS-denied environments, validated with field-test flight data and accuracy improvements.
Presents LiDAR-based high-precision mapping with a MetaScan multi-frame matching method for UAV localization in GNSS-denied environments, verified experimentally.

Presents a UAV SLAM framework with sensor fusion, visual-inertial odometry, and object detection for indoor navigation and search-and-rescue in GPS-denied environments, with simulation and flight tests.

Presents NaviLoc, a training-free trajectory-level visual localization method fusing image matching and VIO for GNSS-denied UAV navigation, achieving 19.5 m mean localization error with embedded deployment.
Presents an autonomous heterogeneous multirobot system (UAVs and USV) for object retrieval in GNSS-denied maritime environments using UWB beacons for UAV localization, validated in field trials.
Presents a UAV localization method fusing visual-inertial odometry, EKF, optical flow, and adaptive KAZE feature matching for GPS-denied environments, validated in simulation.

Presents a generic plug-and-play navigation fusion strategy using improved factor graph optimization for land vehicles in GNSS-denied environments, validated experimentally with multiple sensor configurations.
Presents a georeferenced UAV localization framework using scene matching with orthorectified aerial imagery and EKF sensor fusion for GNSS-denied mountainous terrain, validated in flight tests.
Presents a neural network-based SLAM/GNSS fusion localization algorithm for agricultural robots in orchard GNSS-denied environments, validated experimentally with improved positioning accuracy.

Presents a GPS-denied navigation scheme for light aircraft/UAVs using synthetic aperture radar imagery and the Range-Doppler algorithm fused with inertial navigation, validated with real and simulated radar images.
Presents a tightly coupled LiDAR-inertial odometry and mapping system for autonomous vehicles in GPS-denied underground parking lots, validated in real-time experiments.

Presents IRF-LIL, an infrared rangefinder-fused LiDAR-inertial localization system for UAV bridge inspection in GPS-denied environments, achieving 0.17 m absolute position error in real bridge experiments.

Presents a VIO-UWB collaborative localization approach for dense scene reconstruction in heterogeneous ground-robot and MAV systems in GNSS-denied environments, validated in simulation and real experiments.

Presents an autonomous ground robot for GPS-denied search-and-rescue integrating thermal-visual-inertial odometry with ZUPT localization and PPO planning, validated across simulated disaster scenarios.
Presents a high-resolution intensity LiDAR-inertial 3D mapping approach with novel cylinder feature detection for UAV-based aircraft inspection in GNSS-denied hangar environments.
Presents TerraSLAM, a 3D GIS-based global positioning system that enhances visual SLAM for GPS-denied localization with GPS-RTK-comparable accuracy, validated in drone localization scenarios.
Presents DeepVIONet, a deep learning framework for multi-modal visual-inertial pose estimation for autonomous UAV navigation in GPS-denied environments, evaluated on the TUM Visual-Inertial dataset.

Presents a road semantic-enhanced integrated navigation approach fusing visual semantics (lane lines, poles) with GNSS/INS for land vehicles in urban GNSS-denied environments, validated in field tests.
Presents a novel UAV-UGV collaborative 3D mapping framework with multi-resolution hybrid map fusion for GNSS-denied and unknown environments, validated in real robotic systems.
Presents an aerial-ground multi-agent cooperative localization framework using collaborative SLAM (ORB-SLAM3, PnP, factor graph) for GNSS-denied environments, validated in simulation.
Presents a GNSS-denied UAV localization method using the CLIP model for UAV-satellite image matching to derive location and heading, validated over a 2.23 km2 region.
Presents an inertial navigation filter using magnetometer, Pitot tube, and air vanes to reduce GNSS-denied navigation errors for fixed-wing UAVs, validated via high-fidelity Monte Carlo simulations.
Presents a spectral-normalized memory neural network estimator using rotor RPMs fused with an EKF for computationally light GPS-denied position estimation of micro-UAVs, validated with flight data.
Presents a tether-based indoor UAV localization method using catenary mechanics modeling from tether sensory feedback for GPS-denied environments, validated on a physical tethered robot.
Presents a dilated convolutional neural network framework with low-cost IMUs and extended nonholonomic constraints for navigation in GNSS-denied traffic environments, validated on a GNSS/INS dataset.
Presents a vision, UWB, and system-information-based navigation scheme for UAV autonomous docking on a moving UGV in GPS-denied environments, validated numerically and experimentally.
Presents a drone precision-landing approach integrating a smartphone vision-based guidance sensor with VIO in a GPS-denied environment, validated in landing experiments.
Presents a vision-based UAV localization framework using CLIP aerial-satellite image matching for GNSS-denied navigation, achieving position and heading estimates over a 2.23 km2 area.
Presents a LiDAR scan-matching-aided INS integrated with a loosely coupled EKF for GNSS-denied environments, achieving centimetre-level positioning accuracy in field tests.
Presents a tightly coupled derivative-enhanced camera-IMU-UWB fusion approach for GNSS-denied UAV navigation, validated on the EuRoC dataset with improved localization accuracy.

Presents RWA-YOLO, a vision-based object detection and 3D multi-view geometric localization system for UAVs in indoor GPS-denied environments with low light, achieving sub-centimeter positioning accuracy.
Presents a monocular vision-aided inertial navigation system (V-INS) for rotorcraft UAVs in GPS-denied indoor and outdoor environments, validated via real-world dynamic flight tests.

Presents an energy-aware adaptive communication framework integrated with lightweight CNN-LSTM edge-AI navigation for decentralized UAV swarms in GNSS-denied environments, evaluated in ROS2/Gazebo/PX4 simulations.
Presents system integration and algorithms enabling high-speed (over 18 m/s) autonomous quadrotor flight and navigation through mixed indoor/outdoor GPS-denied environments.
Presents a fully onboard modular control and lightweight motion planning architecture for autonomous quadrotor navigation on resource-constrained CPUs in GNSS-denied indoor environments.
Presents an all-onboard autonomous drone hunting system using Tiny YOLO and visual servoing for target tracking and follow in GPS-denied environments, validated on a physical platform.
Presents a laser-aided Kalman filter navigation system with loop closure detection and pose graph optimization for Micro Aerial Vehicles in indoor and urban GNSS-denied environments.
Presents a vision-based UAV localization framework using multi-modal terrain data (DSM, slope, aspect, VRM) and stereo vision for GNSS-denied georeferenced matching, achieving 30% drift reduction.

Presents MiNav, a system for autonomous drone navigation in featureless/dark indoor environments using millimeter-wave radar and backscatter tags, achieving median 3D error of 9.1 cm across 165 missions.
Presents a Two-Stage Residual Extended Kalman Filter combining XGBoost and DenseKAN for terrain-aided UAV localization in GNSS-denied environments, reducing RMSE by 57-98%.
Presents a vision-based navigation system for a multirotor UAS to operate in GNSS-denied environments created by radio frequency interference during RFI localization missions.
Presents a monocular-based Simultaneous Control, Localization, and Mapping (SCLAM) system for autonomous UAV navigation in GPS-denied scenarios.
Presents a lightweight computer vision methodology using a depth camera to identify flat landing zones and execute safe autonomous UAV landing in GPS-denied environments.
Presents an absolute velocity estimation method for UAVs using Fourier-based image phase correlation fused with monocular vision, IMU, and sonar via Kalman filtering in GNSS-denied environments.

Presents a Vision Transformer-based aerial-to-OpenStreetMap 2D map matching network fused with visual odometry via particle filtering for urban scale aerial geo-localization in GNSS-denied conditions.
Presents an AI-based pattern matching feature-augmented terrain referenced navigation algorithm for sUAS using radial-scan LiDAR point clouds in GPS-denied environments.

Presents uVGS-2, a micro video guidance sensor framework providing 6-DoF pose estimation using an onboard camera and Lie-algebraic PnP solver for drone and mobile robot proximity maneuvers in GNSS-denied environments.
Presents LOFF, a LiDAR and optical flow fusion odometry method using direction-separated data fusion to resolve degeneracy in GNSS-denied tunnel environments for UAVs.
Presents a structured learning model of environmental deviance to enable autonomous navigation and collision avoidance for drone swarms in GPS-denied environments.
Presents a laser scanner and INS fusion mapping framework using Kalman filtering and optimal smoothing for mobile robots/hovercrafts in GNSS-denied indoor and underground environments.
Presents a two-phase hybrid vision-based localization approach constructing coarse topological and fine metric maps for UAV emergency homing and navigation during GPS signal loss.
Presents an autonomous landing strategy using a pan-tilt based visual servoing (PTBVS) system for rapid UAV landing in GNSS-denied environments.
Presents a visual navigation algorithm based on visual-geography Bundle Adjustment and heterogeneous image matching for UAV real-time geographic pose estimation in GNSS-denied environments.
Presents ALM-LED, an autonomous LiDAR mapping and flight trajectory optimization framework for anti-collision drones operating in GNSS-denied underground spaces.
Presents PSD (Point-to-Surfel Distance), a probabilistic 6D localization algorithm using 3D laser scanners on 2.5D surfel maps for mobile robots in landmark-free GPS-denied rough terrain.
Presents Range-Visual-Inertial Odometry (RVIO) with 1D LRF scale correction and coarse-to-fine CNN image registration geo-localization for UAVs in GNSS-denied environments.
Presents a tightly coupled air-ground collaborative system with UAV YOLOv8 perception mapping and ground UGV A* path planning for navigation in GPS-denied cluttered environments.
Presents a comparative study of non-visual terrain-aided navigation methods (TERCOM vs SITAN with EKF/UKF/RLS) integrated with KD-Tree search space reduction for UAVs in GPS-denied environments.
Presents an autonomous UAV positioning system integrating Multi-scale Oriented Gradient Fusion (MOGF) image matching with INS on an onboard computing platform for GNSS-denied flight.
Presents onboard probabilistic 3D localization for aerial robots in industrial GNSS-denied environments using a 3D laser scanner, radio sensors, prior map, and odometry.
Presents a loosely-coupled visual-inertial sensor fusion framework based on Kernel Adaptive Filtering (KLMS in tensor product RKHS) for UAV indoor navigation in GPS-denied environments.
Presents SpeedNet, a dual-channel CNN-GRU network with adaptive ZUPT/ZIHR/NHC3 filtering and joint Bayesian noise optimization for vehicle dead reckoning in GNSS-denied environments.

Presents a high-precision point cloud matching and contextual consistency optimization method to generate ground truth trajectories for evaluating SLAM algorithms in GNSS-denied indoor/underground spaces.
Presents performance evaluation and algorithms for high-grade Hemispherical Resonator Gyro (HRG)-based INS aided by ZUPT and NHC for land vehicle navigation in fully GNSS-denied environments.
Presents a factor graph optimization (FGO) visual SLAM algorithm integrating HD map lane constraints and IMU preintegration to eliminate cumulative positioning errors in GNSS-denied urban areas.
Presents autonomous hovering and trajectory tracking for quadrotor UAVs in GPS-denied urban/indoor environments using miniature laser range finder and Point-to-Line ICP (PLICP).
Presents an adaptive formation control strategy for multi-UAV cooperative relative localization in GNSS-denied environments near structures (e.g. under bridges) to physically avoid multipath regions.
Presents an Artificial Immune System (AIS) methodology to correct dead reckoning algorithms for autonomous UAV position and velocity estimation in GNSS-denied environments.
Presents a data fusion navigation system integrating downward-facing optical flow vision with IMU dead reckoning to reduce cumulative position drift for UAVs in GPS-denied environments.
Presents a Dilution of Precision (DOP) geometry optimization method for high-flying anchor UAVs to provide range-radio cooperative positioning for low-flying UAVs in GNSS-denied environments.
Presents a visual rapid mapping and geolocation framework using camera-equipped UAVs, local SLAM coordinate systems, and line/plane alignment optimization in GNSS-degraded urban environments.
Presents Gradient Perception Approach (GPA), a mapless navigation framework fusing geomagnetic vector gradient perception with INS using constrained Model Predictive Control for GPS-denied flight.
Presents a distributed cooperative navigation method with a 9-dimensional state model and particle-based measurement noise estimation for UAV swarms in partial GNSS-denied environments.

Presents a visual inertial navigation filter formulated on the SO(3) manifold utilizing virtual vision sensor (VVS) incremental displacement outputs for long-distance fixed-wing UAV flight in GNSS-denied conditions.
Presents a LiDAR-based formation localization algorithm using k-means vector matching integrated with a reinforcement learning controller for close-formation UAV flight in GPS-denied environments.
Presents a deep reinforcement learning (PPO and REINFORCE actor-critic) decision-support system for autonomous 3D quadrotor control and navigation under GNSS denial and RF jamming.
Presents a lightweight navigation framework integrating Intel RealSense depth camera, RTAB-Map SLAM, and direction-oriented frontier exploration for UAVs in forest-like GNSS-denied environments.

Presents a hierarchical absolute visual localization system combining DINOv2 image retrieval, SuperPoint feature registration, IMU correction, and sliding-window map updating for UAVs in GNSS-denied environments.

Presents a multi-agent distributed UWB-based cooperative localization system analyzing non-stationary measurement noise, validated with a 5-UAV physical swarm prototype in partial GNSS-denied scenarios.
Presents an RFID-based hybrid metric-topological SLAM algorithm using normalized-cut tag clustering and particle filtering for autonomous navigation in GPS-denied environments.

Presents an image matching-based visual-inertial integrated navigation system using deep learning feature matching, ESKF fusion, and Kalman innovation mismatch detection for UAVs in GNSS-denied environments.
Presents a road similarity-based BEV-satellite image matching algorithm fused with LiDAR-inertial odometry and particle filtering for UGV localization in GNSS-denied off-road environments over 10 km.
Presents EKF monocular SLAM aided by attitude, altitude, and single range-to-base measurements for UAV drift mitigation in GPS-denied environments.
Presents a computer vision fiducial marker-based localization system for autonomous UAV inspection of civil infrastructure in GPS-denied environments with magnetic interference.
Presents a LiDAR and V2X communication cooperative positioning technique for autonomous ground vehicle navigation during GNSS-denied driving scenarios.
Presents and evaluates multi-sensor fusion schemes integrating VIO, LIO, and redundant IMUs (RIMU) into INS/GNSS to suppress drift during long GNSS outages in underground parking environments.
Presents a ROS and 4D/RCS based distributed control and EKF-based marker mapping and SLAM system for multi-quadrotor cooperative navigation in GPS-denied environments.
Presents a hierarchical visual SLAM framework using monocular homography motion estimation fused with IMU via indirect EKF for small UAVs in GPS-denied environments.
Presents system design and field-testing of a cooperative UAV-UGV team where the UGV uses 3D LiDAR, fisheye camera, and UWB to map subterranean environments and track the UAV.
Presents SOFT-SLAM, a computationally efficient stereo visual SLAM algorithm combining stereo feature-tracking odometry (SOFT) with pose graph optimization for autonomous UAV inspection.
Presents a Visual SLAM implementation using onboard cameras and feature tracking for Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) UAS navigation in GPS-denied and congested airspace.

Presents a cooperative optimization framework for simultaneous UAV localization and UWB tag calibration integrating IMU, barometer, and randomly deployed UWB slant range measurements in underground environments.
Presents an integrated ROS/PX4 autonomy framework for UAV perception, visual localization, and obstacle avoidance in GNSS-denied environments validated in simulation and the Leonardo Drone Contest.
Presents an EKF-SLAM optical-inertial navigation solution that tracks underlying surface keypoints to bound inertial navigation errors for UAVs in GNSS-denied environments.
Presents an integrated cyber-physical air-ground system coordinating an autonomous UAV and wheel loader via SLAM and Digital Twin mapping in GNSS-denied post-blast tunnels.
Presents a DNN-based optical-aided navigation system using deep feature matching and optical flow deployed on embedded GPUs to correct IMU drift for UAVs in GNSS-denied environments.
